notes.title: Price Changes and Upcoming Release
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Over night (German time), there was a little store hiccup and we apologize. It showed that the game would cost $5.99 which was incorrect and is now corrected. Steam support unfortunately launched our new pricing model before it was even prepared, this was not done by us.

The price of $5.99 (4.99€) is only for Episode 1 and the remaining episodes will be available for $19.99 (16,79€). If you have bought the game for the lower price, you will only get Episode 1 but you can still upgrade to the full season. If you don't accept that pricing model, because of misinformation during that time, we'd encourage a refund.

Episode 2 and 3 will be released on April 12th, we will increase the price a couple of days prior to that. Buying episode 1 and the season pass (2-4) separately will cost $25.98. If you buy the bundle it will be at a reduced price. 

[h1][b]Note that if you have already purchased the game for the old price or will buy it before the next release, you will be unaffected by the increased price and will get all episodes.[/b][/h1]

The reason why we are doing this is because the scope of the game expanded rapidly. Our initial price decision was based on the plan of episodes that are around 1.5 hours long, but with more story and gameplay the episodes now stretch to around 4-5 hours. That's more than double the content. We also wanted to offer Episode 1 as a single purchase to offer players an entry to the game at a lower cost.


Your
Zein & Kevin

notes.title: Transmission #29: Double Release
notes.content:
Hello there, hackers!

You've been probably wondering what we've been up to and how's the project going, right? Ususally, it's a good sign when you don't hear from us... it means we're deep in the development tunnel, which we were!

You've been waiting a long time and we need you to be patient a little bit longer, but... you'll get [b]TWO NEW EPISODES[/b] in Q1 2019! 

The reason why it's taking so long is that the [i]Episode 2: Memory[/i] and [i]Episode 3: Backdoor[/i] are very intertwined, both in story and gameplay. There were many things that we shifted between episodes to make a better experience out of it. So by the time we entered testing phase for Ep 2, we already had so much stuff for Episode 3 done, that we decided it makes more sense to launch both of them together.

For us this makes also more sense from a financial standpoint, since we can record the voices in one go. 

That means we'll be delivering around 10 hours of play time by the time of March!

[h1]Gameplay (Ep. 2) [/h1]

Sneak around with Agent Bear and plot navigation routes past hostiles. Give him commands to start and stop in realtime and distract enemies with different methods to bring your partner safely to your destination.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/fZYE9OIDoCgkcmwre1/giphy.gif[/img]


Help Raven infiltrate locations by finding information about personnel and files regarding their appearance to construct a disguise file and gain access to restricted areas.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/dScZ10sfmZEvo1P4SF/giphy.gif[/img]

That's it for now! We hope you'll have wonderful holidays! Don't forget to join our Discord channel to stay updated about development: http://www.discord.gg/code7

Cheers,

Kevin & Zein

notes.title: Facing Episode 2
notes.content:
Hey there, hackers! It's time for another update.

We try to keep you updated on a regular basis but the further we dive into the episode's development the less spoiler-free content we have to share. We still try our best to give you tidbits of news now and then!


[h1] Story Progress (Spoiler-free) [/h1]

The last couple of weeks we have been finalizing and tweaking the story for episode 2. We want it to be exciting, dramatic and suspenseful but also tying into the previous narrative. Even though we know what we want from each episode's story, there are so many fine nuances of how to get there. What are the character's desires? Their fears? How does everything play together? How does Episode 2 develop its own story while still feeding into the main story? 

At this state, we're very happy with the story of Bear and Raven and we hope you will be, too! We have started to think about the key art and [url=https://paintpaul.com/] Paul [/url] has already worked on a composition and color draft of it that we really like and we'd like to share with you!

[img] https://image.ibb.co/k1SHLJ/1d302f1f29ad9cae322d4c81bdb1c596_original.png [/img]
[i] Three characters standing in a futuristic city alley, a menacing giant overshadowing the skyline [/i]


A while ago we announced that we combined two episodes in order to have a better story flow. This also led to a little change in the main characters. The agent Bear / Berhanu who was initially planned to be portrayed by Zein is being portrayed by the main character from the episode that got fused with the current one. We also now have a face for Raven. So meet our heroes for episode 2 (portraits not final):

[img] https://image.ibb.co/kcX6Ed/aaf38c24c47df21d39b97bec381b21b6_original.png [/img]



[h1] Programming Hacking Game [/h1]

A new mini game will be introduced in the next episode in which you will be able to program a cute little robot named Muffin in order to cross air shafts and reach rooms you otherwise couldn't. Don't worry! You don't need knowledge in programming in order to control Muffin. With simple lines of code you'll make the little robot move in different directions, push buttons and find the way out.

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/LpGbzGKiOQLvIqnNq1/giphy.gif [/img]

This mechanic ties together with Bear's stealth mechanic. You need to send Muffin through air shafts to reach rooms in which you can distract enemies. Sometimes you need to "park" Muffin in another room to access it without your partner being there. 

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/ZgVRyL76nQdQ1cPIfA/giphy.gif [/img]
[i] Alex distracts a guard with sounds of a printer [/i]


Also the MiM hacking game gets expanded with switches and buttons. The message will sometimes only be triggered manually by the player so they have to time it right. This way the hacking games get a little trickier and tactical.

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/9oHV6G0cuNYHjb5kRM/giphy.gif [/img]


[h1] Event: Open Squares [/h1]

We'll be on the [url=https://www.open-source-festival.de/] Open Source Festival [/url] on July 14th in Düsseldorf, showcasing the game and the escape room hacking game that we showed at gamescom. A lot of people enjoyed it, so if you missed it: here's another chance to be a real-world hacker!


[img] https://image.ibb.co/mL0F7y/c8c6d3a360483e196eeef58176f9e1dc_original.jpg [/img]


That's all for now! Don't hesitate to shoot us a question if you want to know anything about the game and don't forget to join our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/code7] Discord Channel [/url] to get more frequent, little updates.

Your Kevin & Zein

notes.title: Winter Update and Charity Sale
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29600143/7e511429c3d8e674c115df6211374e0322a71af8.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

we hope you're all doing well and are prepared for Christmas and the end of the year! We've been busy improving Episode 1 and adding features and are launching the big winter update, before logging off for the holidays.


[h1]German Version[/h1]

We're happy to announce that with today's update the German translation is available. You can change the language in the main menu. Note, that the audio is still english, but all texts are now available in German.



[h1] Accessible Version [/h1]

The accessible mode for blind and visually impaired players is now available and can be activated with CTRL + V. We hope you enjoy the game! We love to make games more accessible for everyone and are learning with every step. We're happy and thankful to have your support and feedback, it helped a lot!

On Steam, the update will download automatically. You'll have to re-download the DRM-free version. The update also includes a few minor tweaks and bug fixes. Also, the achievement Antibiotic is now possible to achieve as intended.


[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29600143/b6d9ac789456a68dea46da68d9cbf5044192c6ac.jpg[/img]
 
 
[h1]Charity Sale[/h1]

To celebrate the accessible version, [b]between Dec 13th and Dec 26th, we are donating 10% of Code 7's revenue to [url=http://blista.de]blista [/url] [/b]. blista is a competence center for blind and visually-impaired people and at the same time an open and lively education and meeting site for all ages.

Help us share this event and create awareness for accessibility in gaming. Spread the hashtag [b]#gamingwithoutbarriers![/b]



Thank you all for your support and patience. Have a wonderful Christmas and a great start into the year!



Yours,
Kevin and Zein

[*] fixed an issue that made two of episode 1's achievements impossible (Matters of Security and Antibiotic)
[*] minor fixes and tweaks

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
Patch Notes (Version 1.2.0.1)

Hello, everyone! Thank you all who reported bugs and made it easier for us to fix them. For anyone who doesn't know where to report bugs, you can report them as tickets in our trello board: https://trello.com/b/FBNXZCCs/code-7-bugs
You have to comment on the card with the star to get added as a contributor.

Here are the changes:
[list]
[*]Performance improvements in Network and Man-in-the-Middle Modes
[*]Notes app now saves properly
[*]The audio logs on Jenna's tablet are now accessible and not [NULL]
[*]Fixed the issue where the Greenhouse dialogue would start from the beginning, although already completed
[*]Fixed a bug where NPHINEAS would be accessible from other rooms
[*]Fixed a bug where HKRAGER was accessible through network even though it was turned off physically
[*]Fixed the issue where some passwords showed in cryptic symbols after hack
[*]minor bugs fixes and some typos corrected

The current version number of the game is displayed in the bottom left corner of the settings screen.
